Definition: properly, to shield; encompass with; figuratively, to rescue, to hand safely over (i.e. surrender)
BiblicalUsage: Magen means to hand over, to deliver up, and it carries both rescue and surrender in the same breath. Genesis 14:20 blesses the most high God, which hath delivered thine enemies into thy hand, and Proverbs 4:9 says wisdom shall deliver to thine head a crown of glory. Hosea 11:8 turns the word toward God's own heart: how shall I give thee up, Ephraim, how shall I deliver thee, Israel?
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Hosea 11:8 is the tenderest use of this word: the God who delivers enemies into our hands cannot bear to deliver us into theirs. My position is that the handing over in Genesis 14:20 and the refusal to hand over in Hosea 11:8 are the same love, working both ways.
